doc: DiffLlama (DiffLlamaForCausalLM, differential attention, https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.05258; transformers 5.17 modular_diffllama.py): Llama's pre-norm decoder whose attention runs once over the keys and a double-wide value [V_g | V_{g+Hkv/2}] per kv head, subtracts the second half of the heads' contexts from the first with a learned lambda, RMS-norms each pair over 2*head_dim without a gain and scales by 1 - lambda_init (ATTN_DIFFERENTIAL_V1). lambda = exp(sum lambda_q1*lambda_k1) - exp(sum lambda_q2*lambda_k2) + lambda_init(layer), lambda_init(layer) = 0.8 - 0.6*exp(-0.3*layer): a constant of the layer's weights, made at conversion. num_key_value_heads must be even; attention_dropout > 0 is refused (HF refuses it too). Features: ATTN_DIFFERENTIAL_V1, ATTN_GQA_V1, ROPE_DEFAULT_V1, NORM_RMS_V1, MLP_DENSE_GATED_V1.

$forbid: DiffLlama refuses attention_dropout > 0: the differential combination has no defined dropout
